ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/mottled-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and lower lobe surfaces are primarily low-intensity; high-intensity white blobs are localized at distal tips; mottled high-intensity pixels form a border along the trailing edge (approx. top 10-15% of fluke area).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an approximate interior angle of 100 degrees; vertical depth occupies ~12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent small-scale (1-3 pixel) serrations along the full trailing edge margin; distinct larger-amplitude jaggedness at the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge shows a clear concave curvature extending from the notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular white pixel clusters (scars) visible on the dark pigmented area of the lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel high-contrast linear markings (rake marks) visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of rake marks on right lobe; minor notches or 'chipping' on the trailing edge margin of the right tip.
